chunks: Those who deny say to those who affirm: 'Follow our way; we shall carry the burden of your sins.' But they cannot carry the burden of their sins in the least. They are liars indeed.
ai.seo_question: What did the disbelievers claim about carrying the sins of believers?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the theological principle of individual accountability (mas'uliyyah), refuting the notion that spiritual merit or sin can be transferred between individuals. It underscores that while the righteous may intercede by permission, the actual burden of deeds remains with the doer, a concept reinforced by the broader context of Surah Al-Ankabut regarding the trials of faith.
